title: The Slow Bakery
author: Cyrus Oyelaran
blurb: Silas Whitlock, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
